messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up: BlueBridge returned their vendor risk packet — ~12 pages, SOC2 scope, DPA edits, and a 'data residency' matrix. Renewal call Friday. Can we triage answers today? @kevin_onboard @alyssa_security
kevin_onboard: On it. Can you drop the PDF in the shared drive and paste any high-priority Qs?
maria_cs: Uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/cs/bluebridge/bluebridge_vrf_2026.pdf. High-priority: they want 'subprocessor list', 'data deletion SLA 30 days', 'encryption at rest key ownership' and 'SOC2 control IDs for logical access'.
alyssa_security: Quick read: our subprocessors list is public but we need to check if dedicated infra is in scope for them. Encryption: we use customer-keys? For Private we support KMS; Hosted we manage keys. I'll draft a short answer.
kevin_onboard: Also they flagged 'pen-test cadence' and asked for last report date. Do we share the full report or a summary?
tom_legal: cc @alyssa_security @kevin_onboard — legal prefers summary + attest letter, not raw report. On DPA 30-day deletion: our standard is 90 days retained in backups. We can offer 30-day delete for ephemeral data and 90 for backups or propose a contract carveout. I'll draft amendment language.
alyssa_security: Draft answers below, feel free to edit:

- Subprocessors: https://redwood.com/subprocessors
- Data deletion: 'We will delete customer-accessible data within 30 days upon request. Backups are retained up to 90 days for disaster recovery; we can negotiate backup deletion language.'
- Encryption: 'Hosted: keys managed by Redwood (KMS). Private: customer-managed KMS/HSM supported.'
- SOC2: provide control list PTX-01..PTX-12 (will map to their IDs)

Anyone want me to turn this into a spreadsheet Q->Answer?
kevin_onboard: Yes please — spreadsheet makes renewal call smooth. I'll take Qs about onboarding timelines and technical integration notes.
maria_cs: Thanks. Also BlueBridge asked if we can sign their standard DPA with 30-day deletion. Tom, is counter-DPA acceptable or do we push our DPA?
tom_legal: We can't accept full 30 days across the board. Counter-DPA with carveouts is the path. I'll prepare a sign-offable redline by end of day.
integrations_bot: Reminder: renewal call scheduled 2026-03-20 16:00 PT — dial-in: https://meet.redwood.com/renewals/bluebridge
maria_cs: :thumbsup: I'll run through the spreadsheet and send a pre-read to BlueBridge by EOD.
